parent_failed_design.boundary: The failed State-4/State-8 development and its zero semantic refinement remain visible and cannot authorize confirmation.

data_scope.selection_rule: Exclude every previously materialized source_row_id; require the target-blind State-3 projection to differ from State-7 and State-7 to equal the full-event projection; sort by target-excluded selection_id; retain the first 72 rows per task; never use model scores or reference-answer values.
data_scope.no_deletion: All rows, tasks, panels, predictions, invalid outputs, and regressions are retained.

memory_selection: For the queried person, retain the most recent K target-blind ownership-changing events and replay that nested suffix into a canonical inventory/count state. Every retained row is certified before model scoring to have a different State-3 and State-7 projected answer, while State-7 equals the full-event projection.
truncation_disclosure: The 8192-token total context reserves 12 tokens for generation, so prompt input is capped at 8180 tokens with frozen left truncation. Score-free audits on both official Qwen tokenizers and both nodes found exactly 1 of 144 Foundation prompts above the cap: 8223 tokens before truncation, so 43 leading background tokens are removed. The terminal question/answer boundary is preserved; ASCENT state prompts are below the cap. The same row and truncation apply to both models and both state conditions.
development_gate: All provenance, semantic-nonredundancy, Foundation-invariance, and row-alignment checks pass; every cell has positive gain; co-scaled gain and remaining-error increments, the model-by-state interaction, and the 7B state-expansion contrast are all strictly positive. Failure forbids confirmation and forbids tuning the 3/7 state law on these rows.
confirmation_gate: Across all five fixed panels, panel-clustered two-sided t(4) 95% lower bounds are positive for every cell gain, the co-scaled gain increment, the co-scaled remaining-error increment, the model-by-state interaction, and the 7B state-expansion contrast. All provenance, semantic-nonredundancy, row-alignment, Foundation-invariance, task-retention, invalid-output, and regression-retention checks must pass.
interpretation: A neural generative nonredundant-refinement test. Target-blind causal projection supplies a canonical inventory/count prompt, but Qwen must generate and is scored on the public QA7/QA8 answer; this is not the deterministic certified-evidence arm.
paper_rule: A failed frozen gate remains visible and is never repaired by deleting panels, tasks, predictions, invalid outputs, or regressions.
